top_signals.title: Bitcoin Tops $85,000 For First Time Since Late January
top_signals.summary: Bitcoin has surged above $85,000 this morning for the first time since late-January... The rally comes alongside advances in stocks and bonds, as falling oil prices and optimism ahead of a summit between US President Trump and China’s Xi Jinping are buoying markets more broadly. Rival digital assets have also bounced. Ether, the second-largest token, has spiked up to almost $2750, while other cryptocurrencies including XRP, Solana and Monero also posted gains... Bitcoin’s gains build upon a recovery that began late last week, when crypto…
top_signals.why_it_matters: Digital asset volatility and institutional crypto positioning changes.

top_signals.title: Vietnam’s Leader Declares US Trade Deal Close
top_signals.summary: Vietnam’s top leader To Lam tells Bloomberg the nation is “very close” to a trade deal with the US. Vietnam wants to import more US items, Lam says in an exclusive interview on the sidelines of the UN General Assembly. (Source: Bloomberg)
